patches.anchor: ! update the slope parameters for microphysics computation
patches.block:
! POPULATION_TEST_BEGIN
   if(candidate) then
     do k=kts,ktop
       if(cldf(k)>0.) then
         ncr(k,i,2)=ncr(k,i,2)/cldf(k)
         ncr(k,i,3)=ncr(k,i,3)/cldf(k)
       endif
     enddo
   endif
   do k=kts,ktopini
     call capture("PHASE_LOCAL",i,k,loop,[ncr(k,i,1),ncr(k,i,2),ncr(k,i,3),q(k,i),qci(k,i,1),qci(k,i,2),qrs(k,i,1),qrs(k,i,2),qrs(k,i,3),qrs(k,i,4),t(k,i),p(k,i),den(k,i),cldf(k)])
   enddo
! POPULATION_TEST_END

! POPULATION_TEST_BEGIN
   do k=kts,ktopini
     call capture("PHASE_SLOPE",i,k,loop,[ncr(k,i,1),ncr(k,i,2),ncr(k,i,3),q(k,i),qci(k,i,1),qci(k,i,2),qrs(k,i,1),qrs(k,i,2),qrs(k,i,3),qrs(k,i,4),t(k,i),p(k,i),den(k,i),cldf(k),rslopec(k),rslope(k,1),dtcld,lamdacmin,lamdacmax,lamdarmin,lamdarmax])
   enddo
! POPULATION_TEST_END

patches.anchor: ! update the slope parameters and microphysical parameters
patches.block:
! POPULATION_TEST_BEGIN
   do k=kts,ktopini
     call capture("WARM_GRID",i,k,loop,[ncr(k,i,1),ncr(k,i,2),ncr(k,i,3),q(k,i),qci(k,i,1),qci(k,i,2),qrs(k,i,1),qrs(k,i,2),qrs(k,i,3),qrs(k,i,4),t(k,i),p(k,i),den(k,i),cldf(k)])
   enddo
   if(candidate) then
     do k=kts,ktopini
       qci(k,i,1)=qci(k,i,1)/cldf(k)
       qrs(k,i,1)=qrs(k,i,1)/cldf(k)
       ncr(k,i,2)=ncr(k,i,2)/cldf(k)
       ncr(k,i,3)=ncr(k,i,3)/cldf(k)
     enddo
   endif
   do k=kts,ktopini
     call capture("WARM_LOCAL",i,k,loop,[ncr(k,i,1),ncr(k,i,2),ncr(k,i,3),q(k,i),qci(k,i,1),qci(k,i,2),qrs(k,i,1),qrs(k,i,2),qrs(k,i,3),qrs(k,i,4),t(k,i),p(k,i),den(k,i),cldf(k)])

! POPULATION_TEST_END

! POPULATION_TEST_BEGIN

     call capture("WARM_RATES",i,k,loop,[ncr(k,i,1),ncr(k,i,2),ncr(k,i,3),q(k,i),qci(k,i,1),qci(k,i,2),qrs(k,i,1),qrs(k,i,2),qrs(k,i,3),qrs(k,i,4),t(k,i),p(k,i),den(k,i),cldf(k),praut(k),pracw(k),prevp(k),ncaut(k),nraut(k),nccol(k),nracw(k),nrcol(k),dtcld,rslopec(k),rslope(k,1),cpm(k,i)])
   enddo
   if(candidate) then
     do k=kts,ktopini
       qci(k,i,1)=qci(k,i,1)*cldf(k)
       qrs(k,i,1)=qrs(k,i,1)*cldf(k)
       ncr(k,i,2)=ncr(k,i,2)*cldf(k)
       ncr(k,i,3)=ncr(k,i,3)*cldf(k)
       praut(k)=praut(k)*cldf(k)
       pracw(k)=pracw(k)*cldf(k)
       prevp(k)=prevp(k)*cldf(k)
       ncaut(k)=ncaut(k)*cldf(k)
       nraut(k)=nraut(k)*cldf(k)
       nccol(k)=nccol(k)*cldf(k)
       nracw(k)=nracw(k)*cldf(k)
       nrcol(k)=nrcol(k)*cldf(k)
     enddo
   endif
   do k=kts,ktopini
     call capture("WARM_RESTORED",i,k,loop,[ncr(k,i,1),ncr(k,i,2),ncr(k,i,3),q(k,i),qci(k,i,1),qci(k,i,2),qrs(k,i,1),qrs(k,i,2),qrs(k,i,3),qrs(k,i,4),t(k,i),p(k,i),den(k,i),cldf(k),praut(k),pracw(k),prevp(k),ncaut(k),nraut(k),nccol(k),nracw(k),nrcol(k),dtcld])
   enddo
! POPULATION_TEST_END
